title: E08: does a router that owns escalation change a stalling run?
hypothesis: Wiring the M3-01 router into the run path gives it one real decision: with a router in force, `Plan` lowers the repair-race threshold from two verification failures to one, and anything else forbids the spend. On tasks that stall, routing_on therefore escalates earlier and costs more without buying quality; on tasks that never fail verification the two arms are identical.
